labels.rationale: Manually audited at the pin; reported as a proven change. AppFooter is React.memo without a comparator and receives an inline onChange arrow. ExcalidrawWrapper re-renders for forceRefresh (line 453), whose value is never bound and whose setter runs alone in the dev-only debug effect (line 466) and the main menu refresh callback (line 1035), so each such render re-renders AppFooter with equal inputs. The cost is real but small and mostly dev-only. Not enforced because excalidraw-app/App.tsx lies outside the labeled excalidraw targets.

Manually audited at the pin; reported as a candidate. AppMainMenu is React.memo and receives an inline refresh arrow, so renders for errorMessage (378), forceRefresh (453) and latestShareableLink (767) re-render the menu. onCollabDialogOpen, isCollaborating and isCollabDisabled come from atom hooks whose identity the analyzer cannot prove, so the finding stays a candidate. The render cost is low: the main menu renders a trigger only while it is closed.
